titolo: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals massive compute spend and founder control
descr: Anthropic filed a 300‑page S‑1 prospectus on Oct 26, 2026, detailing its financial and operational plans ahead of a public offering.
paragrafi: Anthropic filed a 300‑page S‑1 prospectus on Oct 26, 2026, detailing its financial and operational plans ahead of a public offering.

The filing discloses that the company will spend roughly $3.1 billion per month on Nvidia GPUs from SpaceX, potentially reaching $120.5 billion by 2029, plus billions in commitments with Microsoft, Google and Amazon.
Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei are the highest‑paid executives, receiving $18 million and $16.4 million respectively, along with personal security costs and a private‑jet allowance.
A separate “Founder LLC” will hold 50.1 % of voting power, allowing the seven co‑founders to retain control after the IPO.
Anthropic lists only OpenAI and Google as direct competitors and highlights a cross‑product ecosystem that drives high enterprise spend and 900 % net revenue retention.
perche: The disclosed compute commitments underline the scale of resources needed for leading AI models, affecting pricing and availability for customers. The founder‑controlled voting structure may influence governance and long‑term strategy, which matters to investors and users seeking stability in AI services.
